alt: A home baking display shelf holding ceramic bowls, glass jars, wooden utensils, fresh herbs, and finished pastries arranged with intention in natural morning light.
text:
the city's home bakers are building shrines on their shelves.
ceramic bowls, glass jars, wooden spoons, fresh herbs—arranged in morning light.

the display becomes the ritual. a shelf is a third place when you decide it is.

#bakingasaesthetic #slowmorning #thirdplace
